title: Markerless pose via multi-view / depth (the viable route, future R&D)
description: Single-image 2D markerless ruled out for bare sections (3 methods failed: edge/chamfer/VP-axis — see bd ase). The information to pin a featureless section's pose isn't reliably in one 2D image. Viable markerless needs 3D: (a) MULTI-VIEW from the fixed-camera bay — same scene from known angles -> triangulation -> 3D disambiguates, and reuses bay hardware; (b) DEPTH camera + ICP — fit CAD mesh to a point cloud. Proper R&D: needs reliable ground-truth rig (re-registered markers / controlled setup) to validate. Prereq: fixed-camera bay (bd 5u3) or a depth sensor. Until then markers + constellation are the path. Full investigation log in vault AR-weld-ratification-tool.md.

title: Markerless pose via constrained extrusion-aware alignment (axis VP + end-face)
description: Markerless alternative to markers: user orients the CAD wireframe over the photo in a 3D viewer (calibrated virtual camera = real intrinsics), 'grab this view' = initial 6DoF pose, then backend edge refinement (RAPiD/ViSP-style: project CAD edges, search perpendicular for image gradient, solvePnP, iterate) snaps it onto the steel. New Align tab under PRODUCTION. Backend /ar/edge-refine. Honest risk: steel is edge-ambiguous (rust/clutter/symmetry) so robustness is the open question - spike tests it on real photos. Edge-refine also tightens the marker path (not either/or).
notes: STEP 1 (VP->axis) did NOT validate on real data: 33-50deg vs stored pose, RANSAC worse. Causes unseparable: VP ill-conditioned for near-parallel lines (shallow angle) + the 13px manual-solve 'ground truth' is itself weak in axis/depth. No trustworthy ground truth in-session => can't tune/validate. Needs proper R&D + reliable GT (re-registered markers or controlled rig), not chat spikes. Markerless on bare sections now resisted 3 methods (edge/chamfer/VP-axis). Robust markerless = 3D info (multi-view fixed-camera bay / depth+ICP). Markers work + remain the path. Deferred to proper R&D.

title: CCTV/IP camera ingestion (RTSP + snapshot) for fixed multi-camera QA bay
description: Production capture path for a fixed inspection bay: mount several IP cameras, calibrate each once (fixed = calibration stays valid), and have the BACKEND pull frames on demand via OpenCV cv2.VideoCapture(rtsp://...) or an HTTP JPEG snapshot URL. Each camera = a registered {rtsp/snapshot URL + calibration profile}; a 'grab frame from camera N' endpoint feeds the existing detect/solve/auto-align/constellation flow. Multiple fixed viewpoints pair with the marker-constellation fusion to cover large fabrications. Removes handheld/offload friction (no phone, no file shuffling, no per-shot recal). Camera reqs: 4K/8MP, FIXED-focal lens (not wide dome/varifocal), ONVIF/RTSP + snapshot endpoint, and MUST allow disabling in-camera processing (WDR/NR/sharpening/lens-distortion-correction) or it breaks calibration + fakes edges/markers. Compression (H.264/265) is lossy - pull high-bitrate/snapshot; below machine-vision for ultimate accuracy but fine for QA overlay. Deferred until hardware chosen; webcam (getUserMedia, already built) covers testing meanwhile.

title: AR capture pipeline: ML-ready data schema (BOP-aligned) + provenance/quality logging
description: Bake ML-readiness into the AR capture pipeline from Phase 0/1 (not bolted on later). Every capture = a permanent, fully-described training record. Persist per photo: original full-res image (no recompress, EXIF), exact intrinsics (calibration profile), solved 6DoF pose (label), CAD run_id, camera/lens/zoom + lock state; pose label QUALITY (per-marker reprojection error/confidence); marker pixel regions (for masking so the model can't cheat); adopt BOP dataset format; auto-derive masks + dense image->CAD-surface correspondences by rendering CAD at solved pose; store verification outcomes (discrepancy flags/sign-offs tied to weld ID+image) as a second dataset; log free device extras (ARKit pose, gravity, LiDAR depth); compute/store CAD symmetries + as-designed CAD snapshot; bias capture toward angle/lighting diversity. Rationale + full spec in vault note projects/cad-automation/AR-weld-ratification-tool.md (ML-readiness section). Items 1-3 (provenance, label quality, marker masks) are load-bearing and ~free to add now.

title: AR weld-ratification: Phase 0 projection spike + registration design
description: Next step after the shipped camera-calibration UI (eop). Prove the intrinsics->pose->projection chain: one photo, one marker, one weld cluster, overlay weld polylines from /connections/result/{f} onto a real photo via solvePnP. Then build out the registration design developed 2026-06-11 (see vault note projects/cad-automation/AR-weld-ratification-tool.md): marker constellation, CAD-driven marker placement planner (OBB + faces + weld clusters + classification -> marker plan + bill of markers), feature-based pose refinement (donut/hole-concentric + corner/edge markers; targeted signature search doubles as ratification), magnetic rigid marker kit with standoff offset + unique IDs. Spike ONE region first. Design only so far; no AR code written.

title: Excel BOM: itemise multi_solid CNC parts into per-solid rows
description: bom_excel._write_cnc_sheet writes one row per BOM item using top-level cnc.mass_kg/dims, which are None for multi_solid results (per-solid data lives in solids[]). So multi-solid weldments (e.g. Main Frame on run e8a0ba3c) render as a single row with blank dims/mass and contribute 0 to CNC total weight in the Summary sheet. Pre-existing for any multi-solid part, surfaced by cad-automation-stage2-s10. Fix: expand multi_solid results into one row per solid (mirror bom_builder._rows_for_instance), or aggregate mass across solids for the single row + show solid count. Affects Summary weight totals too.

title: Handheld AR inspection: decide live tracking vs capture-and-review (gates any Unity work)
description: Open prerequisite surfaced by ADR 0003 (vault: projects/cad-automation/decisions/0003-no-unity-for-the-weld-cell.md). Unity + AR Foundation is the settled answer for handheld AR ONLY IF we want LIVE camera-tracked overlay — because iOS Safari has no WebXR immersive-AR, so the existing web stack cannot deliver live overlay on an iPad. If capture-and-review (shoot stills, solve, review) is the better shop-floor QA workflow, no Unity is needed at all: still-photo overlay is already built and proven (Phase 0/1, solvePnP + 2D draw). Answer this BEFORE any handheld build work. Note handheld is currently shelved by the 2026-06-14 pivot to the fixed cell (epic cad-automation-stage2-zq7).
notes: Do not reopen the Unity question generally — ADR 0003 settles it. This bead is only the live-vs-stills workflow decision.

value: cad-automation runs uvicorn WITHOUT --reload (docker-compose command override). The Windows Docker bind mount breaks watchfiles: plain --reload doesn't detect edits; WATCHFILES_FORCE_POLLING=true fires phantom restarts + crashes (os error 5) that KILL in-flight analysis/classify/STL subprocesses (symptom: 'stuck detecting'). Do NOT re-add --reload or polling. After backend (Python) edits, manually: docker restart cad-automation-api. Frontend (static JS/CSS) just needs a browser reload.

cad-automation section library (app/pipeline/data/Shape_classifier_info.json) has TWO MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE HALVES, marked by a 'hollow': true flag. Open: UB/UC/UBP/RSJ/RSC/PFC/EA/UEA (code_profile I/U/L). Hollow: CHS/SHS/RHS, EN 10210 hot-finished, 263 entries (code_profile RO=round, RU=rectangular), added 2026-07-17 (bd b5b, commit 0a79307) and GENERATED by scripts/gen_hollow_sections.py --write (re-runnable; --check validates the formulae against published values). classify_profile(cs, lib, hollow=False) selects the half; hollow=False is the default and preserves open-only behaviour. NEVER let the halves cross: matching a tube against open profiles is what matched a 33.7 CHS handrail to EA 35x35x4 and cut 52 wrong NC1s (bd 5wg), because a round tube's fill ratio (0.27) sits in the same band as an angle's and PASS 3 is angle-biased. HOLLOW MATCHES ON CSA, NOT DIMS: a smooth cylinder has no straight edges for align_by_longest_straight_edge, so a raked tube skews and its OBB cross-section inflates (measured ODs smeared 33.7->41.9, no standard sizes); CSA=volume/length is immune and put 63/64 on a real size. The OBB is used only as a VETO (a section cannot exceed its own bbox) to break CSA collisions. NO NC1 IS GENERATED FOR HOLLOW - compute_dstv_pose only special-cases U and L and hole projection assumes webs/flanges, so tube NC1 would be unvalidated; _process_hollow_match returns designation/CSA/mass with nc1_path=None. Known limit: CSA pins the diameter but the wall only to ~0.2mm, so a tube can straddle two catalogue walls.

cad-automation BOM item numbers (B001..) are allocated by assign_bom_items walking project_state.classifications in INSERTION ORDER, and they also name the output files (rename_files_to_bom_ids -> B042.nc1). They are now PINNED: pin_bom_items(cache) records the assignment in the sidecar 'bom_items' key and assign_bom_items reuses pins, allocating only for new keys (called from _save_project_state). Do not un-pin. Without pinning, any part dropping below the 0.5 auto-apply confidence threshold leaves classifications and everything behind it slides - measured 4295 of 4540 keys moved on one reclassify of run 761b26b1, silently repointing B155 from the M20 bolt group to a different part. A part merely CHANGING action keeps its slot (postprocess/bought-out/exclude are all numbered); only dropping out shifts numbering. Also: classify-frontier skips refs that already have a refined_class (_already()) unless force:true - so classifier rule changes do NOT reach already-classified runs (761b26b1 was 88% stale). Sweep with force:true after any rule change.

Never hand-edit a live sidecar JSON (outputs/analysis/*.json) with raw json.dump while the container is running — concurrent writes corrupt it, and writers' read->pass-on-error->write-own-section pattern then clobbers all other sections (lost run c25bf2c8 project_state+analysis, 2026-06-17). Use the API or stop the container. Writers now use app/services/sidecar.py (atomic_write_json + load_sidecar corrupt-guard).
